fixed.summary: A document element's style warnings (a missing token, a value invalid at computed-value time, an -og-burst keyframe whose var() does not resolve) are in every frame's warnings while they hold, not only in the frame the element was styled again; they go when the element is styled without them or leaves. An `<svg width="0" height="0">` holding only `<defs>` no longer warns that its viewBox has no size: only a viewBox the author wrote is checked.
